description: Split a restaurant bill with tax/service and tip, in whole cents so the shares always add up exactly (left-over cents go to the largest remainders). simple: one bill split evenly between N people (1–100). items: list who had what; each item is split between the people who shared it (nobody listed = everyone), and tax and tip are shared in proportion. Tip can be on the subtotal or on subtotal + tax; each share can be rounded up to a step (e.g. 0.5 or 1). Returns a ready-to-send summary. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/split-bill/

bill.description: simple: the bill subtotal (before tax and tip).

sharedBy.description: Names who shared it (omit or [] = everyone).

people.description: simple: how many people (default 2). items: the names, e.g. ["Sara", "Omar", "Lina"].

roundUpTo.description: Round each share up to a multiple of this (e.g. 0.5, 1, 5). 0 = exact.

tipOnTax.description: Calculate the tip on subtotal + tax.

name: calc_split_bill
title: Split a bill
